LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_ChooseMemberFirst: This source can produce multiple entities. Choose a specific member first.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_CinematicRecordFacing: Choose actor from entity book, then record facing
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_CinematicRecordFromMap: Record with an actor from the current map
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_CinematicRecordMove: Choose actor from entity book, then record movement
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_CinematicReferenceInvalid: Select one actor from the entity book. For a source with multiple actors, choose a specific member.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_CinematicReference_Tip: Choose spawn data or an entity template. You can author a scene before the actor has spawned.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_CinematicSource_Tip: During normal playback, use the actor actually created by this source. The rehearsal actor is used only while authoring and testing a copy.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_ContextTip: Shows entities generated from this source within the current quest. Without a quest, only unassigned generation records are shown. Runtime references resolve against the calling quest.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_InvalidIdentity: The entity recipe identity is invalid.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_InvalidRecipe: Complete the required pawn kind or entity template before saving this recipe.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_InvalidReference: This entity reference is invalid. Choose it again from the entity book.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_MemberNumberTip: Member numbers start at 1 and remain stable in generation order for this source. You can select a future member before generation.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_MemberRequired: “{0}” has {1} members. Choose a specific member.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_MemberUnavailable: Member {1} of “{0}” is unavailable. Choose another member.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_NotGenerated: “{0}” has not spawned or has no available members.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_OpenDescription: Browse spawn recipes and entity templates, inspect generated members, and choose entities for actions or cinematics.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_PreviewTemplate: Template preview only. It is not placed on the map or registered as a generated entity.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_SaveAsNewTip: Creates a separate source. Existing cinematics and actions keep their references to the original recipe.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_SearchTip: Search by name, source, or identity.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_SelectEntry: Select an entry on the left to view details.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_StatusTip: Generation records belong to the current world and quest. You can select a recipe before generation. Sources with multiple members require an explicit member selection. Dead, destroyed, or missing objects are shown as unavailable.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_Unavailable: The entity book is unavailable in the current game.
LanguageData.CQF_EntityBook_UseRecipeTip: Copies configuration values so later edits remain independent. The copy keeps the same entity source; multiple generated entities become separate members. Save as a new recipe first when a separate source is required.
